Hello there!🌼
I’m Dr. Muskan Moudgill, a passionate veterinarian from India, here to show the world that veterinary medicine is more than just a profession — it's a kaleidoscope of emotions, stories, science, and heart.

Whether you're a pet parent, vet student, or someone who loves animals — join me as I explore all shades of vet life: pet care tips, behind-the-scenes, student struggles, inspiring cases, and heartfelt stories.

🎥 Real, relatable, and rooted in compassion.
Let’s make vet med visible. Let’s make it magical.

🐾 Subscribe & become part of the Vet Rainbow family!
